data: Microsoft's operating income for fiscal 2024 (year ended June 30, 2024) was about $109.4 billion on revenue of roughly $245.1 billion, a margin of around 44.6%. Amazon's operating income for fiscal 2024 (year ended December 31, 2024) was about $68.6 billion on net sales of roughly $638.0 billion, a margin of around 10.8%. Microsoft's figure is therefore the larger one, at about 1.6 times Amazon's ($109.4 billion divided by $68.6 billion is roughly 1.59). Note that the two companies' fiscal years end at different times, so the periods are not perfectly aligned, and these figures come from my recollection of their annual reports rather than a live lookup, so check them against the 10-K filings if precision matters.
